description: React component for managing model aliases in a UI, including adding, editing, deleting, and displaying alias configurations.

classes.name: ModelAliasManager
classes.description: React functional component that manages a list of model aliases with add, edit, delete functionalities.

methods.name: handleAddAlias
methods.description: Adds a new alias to the list after validation, then updates parent component if callback provided.

methods.name: handleEditAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias to be edited into editing mode.

methods.name: handleUpdateAlias
methods.description: Saves modifications made to an alias, updates list, and notifies parent.

methods.name: handleCancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the current alias editing mode.

methods.name: deleteAlias
methods.description: Removes an alias from the list and notifies parent component.
